# Monsters of Drakkenheim (MoDk)
___
## Amalgamation
*Gargantuan Aberration (Epic Boss)*
___
- **[[Armor Class]]** 18
- **[[Hit Point|Hit Points]]** 175 (10d20 + 70) plus 175 (10d20 + 70) per [[player character]]
- **[[Speed]]** 5 ft.
- **[[Initiative]]** +14 (24)
___

|   STR    |   DEX   |   CON   |   INT   |   WIS   |   CHA   |
| :------: | :-----: | :-----: | :-----: | :-----: | :-----: |
| 30 (+10) | 11 (+0) | 27 (+8) | 22 (+6) | 18 (+4) | 20 (+5) |
___
- **[[Saving Throw|Saving Throws]]** Str +17, Dex +7, Con +14, Int +13, Wis +11
- **Skills** [[Arcana]] +13, [[Deception]] +12, [[Insight]] +11, [[Perception]] +11
- **Immunities** Psychic; [[Charmed]], [[Exhaustion]], [[Frightened]], [[Paralyzed]], [[Petrified]], [[Poisoned]], [[Prone]], [[Stunned]]
- **Senses** [[Truesight]] 60 ft., [[Passive Perception]] 21, Passive Insight 21, Passive Stealth 10
- **Languages** All; telepathy 1 mile
- **Challenge** 23 (XP 50,000; PB +7)
- **[[Proficiency Bonus]]** +7
___
### Traits
***Contaminating Presence.*** A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Amalgamation is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution [[Saving Throw]]:* DC 20. *Failure:* The target gains a [[Contamination]] level. *Failure or Success:* 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.  

***Immutable Form.*** The Amalgamation has [[Immunity]] to any spell or effect that would alter its form.  

***Malignancy.*** The Amalgamation can't be teleported or travel to another plane against its will.  

***Rejuvenation.*** If the Amalgamation is destroyed in the Mortal World, it reappears 1d10 days later with all of its [[Hit Point|Hit Points]] unless its roots in the Space Between Worlds are also destroyed.  

***Ultimate Corruption.*** Necrotic damage dealt by the Amalgamation ignores *[[Resistance]]* and treats [[Immunity]] as [[Resistance]] instead.  

### [[Action|Actions]]
***The Amalgamation always takes its turn on [[Initiative]] count 20.*** On its turn, the Amalgamation can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an [[action]] or [[Bonus Action]] on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Amalgamation takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each [[player character]]'s turn. 

***Bite.*** *Melee Attack Roll:*  +17, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 36 (4d12 + 10) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature [[Grappled]] by the Amalgamation, the [[Grapple Action|grapple]] ends and the target is swallowed. While swallowed, the target has the [[Blinded]] and [[Restrained]] conditions, has [[Total Cover]] from effects originating from outside the Amalgamation, and takes 42 (12d6) Necrotic damage and gains a [[Contamination]] level at the start of each of the Amalgamation's turns.  
If the Amalgamation takes 50+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution [[saving throw]] at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in spaces within 10 feet of the Amalgamation and have the [[Prone|Prone condition]]. If the Amalgamation dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the [[Restrained|Restrained condition]] and can escape the corpse using 15 feet of its movement, exiting with the [[Prone|Prone condition]].  

***Tentacle.*** *Melee Attack Roll:*  +17, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* 28 (4d8 + 10) Force damage, and the target has the [[Grappled|Grappled condition]] (escape DC 25). While [[Grappled]], the target has the [[Restrained|Restrained condition]]. The Amalgamation has twelve tentacles, each of which can [[Grapple Action|grapple]] one target. Fling. One Large or smaller object held or creature [[Grappled]] by the Amalgamation is thrown up to 60 feet, landing with the [[Prone|Prone condition]]. If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 35 (10d6) Force damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity [[saving throw]] or take the same damage and have the [[Prone|Prone condition]].  

***Mind-Breaking Whispers (Recharge 5–6).*** *Intelligence [[Saving Throw]]:* DC 25, one creature within 120 feet of the Amalgamation. *Failure:* The target becomes insane until it finishes a [[Long Rest]]. While insane, the target can't take [[Action|actions]], understand other creatures, read, or speak anything but gibberish. A [[Greater Restoration]] or *[[Heal]]* spell ends the effect early. *Failure or Success:* 70 (20d6) Psychic damage.  

***Forced Mutation (1/Round).*** Each creature within 120 feet of the Amalgamation with one or more [[Contamination]] levels takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and gains a randomly determined mutation.  

***Piper at the Gate (1/Round).*** A [[Pyknic Maunder]] appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the Amalgamation, acting after the Amalgamation on [[Initiative]] count 20 and under the Amalgamation's direct control. The Amalgamation can have up to ten Pyknic Maunders under its control at a time.  

***Epic Resistance.*** The Amalgamation chooses one [[condition]], spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Amalgamation can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take [[Action|actions]], its [[Action|actions]] are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.
